subject: Short Console phrases: subprocessors, transfers, and KMS — quick QA
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: security@neptune.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Short Console phrases: subprocessors, transfers, and KMS — quick QA

Hi Amir / Neptune security team,

Quick note from our Console UX pass: procurement wants one-line, customer-facing phrases for three items that appear in the Hosted API settings and the help flyout: (1) subprocessor disclosure, (2) cross-border transfer safeguards, and (3) key management options. The goal is <120 characters so they fit inline.

Draft options attached (console-blurbs-v1.docx) and pasted below. Please confirm any wording you cannot accept from a compliance standpoint.

Draft A (consumer-short)
- Subprocessors: "We use vetted subprocessors (cloud and CDN partners) to run the service; a list is in our DPA."
- Transfers: "Cross-border transfers are protected by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where applicable."
- Keys: "Optional customer-managed keys via supported KMS integrations."

Draft B (procurement-safe)
- Subprocessors: "Subprocessors (infrastructure and delivery partners) may process content; see the current list in the DPA appendix."
- Transfers: "Transfers are governed by SCCs or other legally recognized safeguards."
- Keys: "We support customer-managed keys; HSM-backed options available for eligible plans."

Notes / ask:
- If you need explicit mention of specific cloud providers (AWS/GCP/Azure), say so and we can add parentheticals.
- If the SCC callout is not sufficient for your EU operations, tell us preferred phrasing.

Wed like to lock this down by EOD Tue so the Console microcopy update can ship next week.

Thanks,
Diego
Director, Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: console-blurbs-v1.docx (2KB), subprocessor-list-snapshot.csv (1KB)

From: Amir Khan <amir.khan@neptune.ai>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 May 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short Console phrases: subprocessors, transfers, and KMS — quick QA

Diego,

Thanks for the clear options. A few quick flags from Neptune security/legal:

- Subprocessors: good to call out cloud providers explicitly (we operate with strict procurement; listing AWS/GCP helps). 
- Transfers: SCCs are fine, but please do NOT use the phrase "where applicable" md it weakens the claim. Use "protected by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)".
- Keys: accurate, but please add a short parenthetical for limitations: "(KMS subject to plan and region availability)".

Also, can you include a short link to the published subprocessor registry in the Console flyout? That helps our audit team.

Amir
Security Operations, Neptune AI
